clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1.   Scope —Requirements for manufacture, dimensions, tolerances and marking for union made of injections moulded PVC for water supplies.

clauses.title: The laying length Z and tolerances there
clauses.text: 2.1 The laying length Z and tolerances there  on shall comply with those given in Table 1. clauses.title: The inside diameter of the socket
clauses.text: 2.2  The inside diameter of the socket  and the length shall comply with those given in IS 7834 (Part 1):1987*
